docs.message:
docs: take the Mathe-Karte out of the platform documents

## Intent

The Mathe-Karte is one app among others. The platform documents should not single it out; where they need an example of the first apps, they point to the app catalogue.

## Key changes

- The MVP design names "the first apps in the app catalogue", linked to lernapps.net/apps/, instead of the Mathe-Karte.
- The scan, the owners chapter and the development plan say that Ralf D. Müller builds apps, without naming the Mathe-Karte.
- The README no longer uses the Mathe-Karte as its example of a repo's own document.

## Dependencies and side effects

- The home page drops the Mathe-Karte in the same step (lernapps.github.io f3fc04f).
- The recorded user answer in the business evidence still names the Mathe-Karte on purpose.

## Intent

The Mathe-Karte is one app among others. The home page should not promote it on its own; the app catalogue is the way to apps.

- The "Ausprobieren: Mathe-Karte" lines for teachers and learners are gone; "Apps finden" still leads to the catalogue.
- llms.txt no longer lists the Mathe-Karte; its apps section points only to the catalogue.
- The README no longer mentions the Mathe-Karte.

## Dependencies and side effects

- The platform documents drop it in the same step (docs 1c52c32).
